answer.says: You are right to correct me, Mrs. Kapoor. I spoke as if the structure were the whole truth, forgetting that the spirit lives in the particular. I will listen.
answer.thought: Her indignation is a check on my abstraction. I had treated the school as a mere mechanism of obedience, but she has shown me the human cost of that mechanism. I must sit and hear her out.
